notes: Modified cash basis school district (Aug 31 FYE), all funds governmental (School Nutrition is reported among Other Governmental Funds), so business_type is null. Governmental lines use the Total Governmental Funds column on p3-4; beginning cash = fund balances beginning of year 'as restated' 7,223,773 (no restatement amount printed, so no adjustment item); ending cash = ending fund balance 7,671,562, which equals cash plus CDs plus county treasurer balances (p5). Transfers of 40,000 (General to Activities) net to zero in the total column so transfers_in/out are null. 'Other nonrevenue receipts' split using General Fund schedule p10; 'Debt service' split into principal (1,210,000) and interest/other costs (59,608) using the Bond, Special Building and QCPU fund schedules (extractor assumption, fund parts of the line); 'Student support services' split by fund column (Activities Fund 495,426 shown as student activities). 'Other local receipts' kept as one line (41,176) with category donations/contributions. Balance sheet uses the government-wide assets/net position section of the Statement of Activities and Net Position (p2); the Capital projects net position line is blank. Detail (attempt 2): General Fund budget-and-actual schedule (pp9-12) used rather than the p6/p7 combining schedule. The 150,000 transfer to the Depreciation Fund is hidden inside General Fund spending lines ('as expensed from the General Fund', p14) and removed by the p6 Reclassifications column: (100,000) from Student transportation, and Instruction +248,613 vs state programs (10,799), other state categorical (7,637), federal programs (280,177) = net 50,000 removed. So line 2710 (299,198) is split into 199,198 spending + (100,000) other financing, and line 6408 (160,336) is split into 110,336 spending + (50,000) other financing (exact program line for the 50,000 is not printed; 6408 chosen as the largest, review). Together with the Depreciation Fund +150,000 transfer in and the General Fund (40,000) transfer / Activities Fund +40,000, transfers now net to zero. The printed General Fund total 10,962,624 includes transfers: expenditure items 10,770,124 plus 190,000 of transfers out (40,000 + 150,000) = 10,960,124, which is 2,500 below the printed total (see report_discrepancies, unchanged). Special Building Fund p17 row labels for 433 / 1,375 / 206 look misprinted; categories follow combining schedule p8 and p3 (public power district sales tax 433, motor vehicle taxes 1,375, interest and penalties 206), original labels kept as printed on p17. Not recorded: lines with a budget but no actual (2733 vehicle servicing SPED ages 3-5 budget 1,850; Special Building and Bond Fund capital outlay budgets), actual printed blank. 2110 County fines and license fees left as county/other local governments. Nonmajor combining schedule (p8) not recorded to avoid double counting. Budget column is Original and Final. Read pages 1-19 of 19.
